owner_text:
In this town, if you get angry even once, you turn into a monster.
So Leo has smiled every single day for three years. Even on the days it really hurt.
His best friend Hana made it easy. All summer, they built a treehouse and sang their own silly song.
But Leo noticed something strange. Whenever the Mayor got upset, he quietly hummed that exact same song.
Then one Friday, the Officer put up a red sign. The Mayor wanted their treehouse torn down.
Hana burst into tears. And for the first time in three years, Leo felt his face getting hot.
He knew the rule. But he couldn't keep smiling while his friend was crying, so he marched to the town square.
"You can't take it from her!" Leo shouted. The Mayor just smiled and waited.
In one flash of light, Leo grew giant horns, sharp claws and a long purple tail.
Everyone screamed and ran away. Everyone except Hana, who walked right up to him and started to sing.
As she sang, his horns started to shrink, and soon Leo was just Leo again.
But that's when the Mayor lost it. His rule had just failed in front of the whole town.
In another flash, he became the biggest monster of all. He had banned anger because he could never control his own.
Years ago, his little sister used to calm him with that song. When she moved away, nobody was left to sing it.
Leo had every reason to stay mad. Instead, he walked up to the monster and sang it for him.
The monster began to cry, and slowly, the Mayor came back. That day, he tore down his rule instead of the treehouse.
Now in this town, you're allowed to get angry, as long as someone stays to sing you back.
